text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam orders cut in electricity fees for house consumption.
- Saddam chairs cabinet meeting, stresses importance of hard work.
- Iraq's foreign minister returns after attending meetings of U.N. General Assembly in New York.
- Newly appointed culture and information minister assumes post.
- Labour minister meets Italian trade union delegation.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraq to organise international trade fair on November 1.
